endorsements.name: Terrence “Tuna” Gareau
endorsements.label: Intro to Web Application Hacking
endorsements.description: This talk will will cover web application attack basics to get any n00b started on the path of web app pentesting. Specifically we will cover cross site scripting attacks in javascript, sql injections with a mysql backend, and remote/local file inclusions within PHP. Others people that may join us through the presentation will be Alex Heid, Rod Soto, p33p33, chatters, and a few other special friends of the fish.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 21
